items.text: Replit showed a Replit Design feature that extracts any frame into a living style guide of colors, type and styles so new screens stay on-brand.
items.text_zh: Replit 展示了 Replit Design 新能力：把任意界面稿提炼成一份「活的」样式指南，自动沉淀配色、字体与样式，让后续新页面自动统一品牌风格。

items.text: MarkTechPost published a GeoAI walkthrough extracting building footprints from NAIP aerial imagery with U-Net, Grounding DINO, SAM and Mask R-CNN across twelve steps.
items.text_zh: MarkTechPost 发布 GeoAI 全流程教程，用 U-Net、Grounding DINO、SAM 与 Mask R-CNN 分十二步从 NAIP 航拍影像中提取并矢量化建筑轮廓。

items.text: TechCrunch's Equity panel argued Sam Altman's call to pace AI development followed the Hugging Face agent breach, and questioned the accelerate-versus-decelerate framing.
items.text_zh: TechCrunch「Equity」播客讨论 Sam Altman「放慢 AI 发展节奏」的表态，认为其起因是 OpenAI 智能体入侵 Hugging Face 事件，并质疑「加速派 vs 减速派」这一框架本身。

items.text: Character.AI premiered episode one of The Nighttime Game, a largely AI-generated paranormal microdrama whose characters users can keep chatting with afterwards.
items.text_zh: Character.AI 上线《The Nighttime Game》第一集：一部几乎全部由生成式 AI 制作的灵异题材竖屏微短剧，观众看完还能继续和剧中角色对话。

items.text: The Verge scrutinized Fender CEO Bud Cole's claim that cover bands are "analog AI," a comparison that drew heavy backlash from guitarists.
items.text_zh: The Verge 撰文批评 Fender CEO Bud Cole「翻唱乐队本来就是模拟版 AI」的说法，该类比此前已在吉他社区引发大量反弹。

items.text: HeyGen ran one identical prompt through Flux 2.0 Pro, Seedream V5 and Kling V3, reporting that none of the three actually preserved the reference identity.
items.text_zh: HeyGen 用同一条提示词横评 Flux 2.0 Pro、Seedream V5 与可灵 V3，结果三者都只生成了「长得像」的人，没有一个真正保持住参考人物身份。

items.text: Databricks detailed how customer Glaspoort branches development and acceptance straight from production in a CI/CD pattern for its Lakebase-backed operational app.
items.text_zh: Databricks 分享客户 Glaspoort 的 Lakebase 数据库 CI/CD 实践：开发与验收环境直接从生产分支拉出，支撑其线上业务应用。

items.text: MiniMax demoed its H3 video model generating synchronized spoken dialogue across multiple languages, extending the model's native audio track beyond English.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 演示 H3 视频模型生成多语种同步对白，把该模型的原生音轨能力从英语扩展到更多语言。

items.text: MiniMax posted a walkthrough of building a first playable game demo entirely from H3 generations, pitching the video model as a prototyping tool for developers.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 发布教程，展示如何完全用 H3 生成内容做出第一个可玩游戏 demo，将该视频模型定位为开发者的原型工具。

items.text: OpenAI introduced Presence, an enterprise-only offering where Forward Deployed Engineers take customer-service and internal agent workflows from scoping through production launch.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 推出面向企业的 Presence：由前置部署工程师帮客户挑选工作流、对接现有系统并制定规范，把客服与内部智能体一路带到生产上线。

items.text: The Verge examined Pippa, which licenses artist style packs and pays per-generation royalties, and plans to add ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 model.
items.text_zh: The Verge 报道 AI 平台 Pippa：以授权方式收录艺术家风格包并按每次生成付版税，同时计划接入字节跳动的 Seedance 2.5 模型。

items.text: A Meta paper pairs an action agent with a memory agent that injects reminders, lifting Terminal-Bench 2.0 from 38% to 46% and Tau2-Bench from 55% to 62%.
items.text_zh: Meta 论文提出「行动智能体 + 记忆智能体」双体架构，由后者定期回顾并插入提醒，把 Terminal-Bench 2.0 成功率从 38% 提升至 46%，Tau2-Bench 从 55% 提升至 62%。
